activity_summary: At night you kept three things. The loaf was a penny, and the wheat was six-and-thirty. You had stopped the tale, and she had heard the stop. The eighteenth is the carrier, at the horses' pace, and you will carry the pack, the sheets, and the inkhorn.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said it low, and stopped on the inkhorn.
